title: sim: sim_finalize_cipher_gcm ignores GCM decrypt return value mapping to EBADMSG
description: In crypto2dev_sim.c, sim_finalize() calls sim_finalize_cipher_gcm() and if it returns non-zero, the ioctl dispatch sets errno = (ret == AES_GCM_AUTH_E) ? EBADMSG : EIO. However wc_AesGcmDecrypt() returns AES_GCM_AUTH_E directly on tag mismatch. sim_finalize_cipher_gcm() passes that return code through (ret is wc_AesGcmDecrypt's return). So errno is correctly set to EBADMSG on authentication failure. This is correct. BUT: sim_finalize_cipher_gcm uses 'wc_AesGcmDecrypt' which returns its own negative error code (e.g., -286 = AES_GCM_AUTH_E). sim_finalize returns that negative code to sim_finalize(). sim_finalize checks 'ret == AES_GCM_AUTH_E' — but AES_GCM_AUTH_E is a negative value and the raw ret is also negative. This comparison works if AES_GCM_AUTH_E == the wolfSSL error code value returned by wc_AesGcmDecrypt. Examining wolfssl source: wc_AesGcmDecrypt returns AES_GCM_AUTH_E on auth failure. sim_finalize_cipher_gcm returns ret directly. AES_GCM_AUTH_E value is defined in error-crypt.h. The check 'ret == AES_GCM_AUTH_E' should match. This is actually correct. Closing as no-bug.
